title: Records of licensees.
bodyText: The board may, by regulations, require licensees to keep such records and information as it deems necessary for the proper enforcement of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§161-16]  Records of licensees.  The board may, by regulations, require licensees to keep such records and information as it deems necessary for the proper enforcement of this chapter. [L 1969, c 212, §12]
